SELECT p.sku, p.style_name, p.size, i.stock_count, i.reorder_point, s.supplier_name, s.on_time_rate 
FROM products p 
JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku 
JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id 
WHERE i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point
detections.insight: The data indicates a high risk of stockouts across various product styles, particularly for the Wool Blend Blazer, with 7 out of 14 products having a stock count less than their reorder point. This suggests a potential operational risk, as stockouts can lead to lost sales, customer dissatisfaction, and ultimately, revenue loss. Furthermore, the on-time rate of suppliers, particularly Tirupur Knitwear Ltd., is high, indicating that the issue may not be with the suppliers' ability to deliver on time, but rather with the company's inventory management and forecasting processes.
detections.recommendation: To mitigate this risk, I recommend that the executive: 1. Conduct a thorough review of the company's inventory management and forecasting processes to identify areas for improvement, and 2. Consider implementing a just-in-time (JIT) inventory management system to reduce stock levels and minimize the risk of stockouts. This proactive approach will enable the company to better manage its inventory, reduce operational risk, and improve overall business performance.
